facts.text: Melanie is carving out me-time each day by running, reading, or playing her violin to stay present for her family.

evidence.quote: Yeah, it's tough. So I'm carving out some me-time each day - running, reading, or playing my violin - which refreshes me and helps me stay present for my fam!
The event was really thought-provoking. I'm starting to realize that self-care is really important.

facts.text: Melanie's children are excited about summer break and are considering a camping trip next month.

evidence.quote: My kids are so excited about summer break! We're thinking about going camping next month.

facts.text: Caroline is researching adoption agencies with the goal of providing a loving home to children in need.

evidence.quote: Researching adoption agencies — it's been a dream to have a family and give a loving home to kids who need it.
My goal is to give kids a loving home. I'm truly grateful for all the support I've got from friends and mentors. Now the hard work starts to turn my dream into a reality.
